doc.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01

title: Memories of the Beverly Cavern, his children, and closing remarks
summary: Allen recalls hearing the band at the Beverly Cavern; Marrero says he has six living children out of sixteen, and the visit winds down with encouragement to Allen.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren
